responsibility_boundary: Exact post-queue workflow authority projection containing both the native Linux ARM64 Hub CLI qualification job and the already-admitted dev-to-Alpha candidate patrol.
cohesion_rationale: The ratchet validates one exact generated authority file after queue integration, so the independently admitted job deltas require one combined current-tree measurement without changing either job's authority boundary.
rejected_split_alternatives: The checker cannot apply two partial line measurements to one exact file state.
A second authority registry would create competing workflow truth sources.
